announcements.title: First Speaker Series Meeting of the Semester!
announcements.body: Interested in getting involved with NAYGN? Join us for our first speaker series meeting of the semester! Find more information on the Calendar page.

announcements.title: Involvement Opportunities with NAYGN
announcements.body: Our mission is to give students from any major who are interested in nuclear energy accessible opportunities to get involved in an intercontinental organization. Through our initiatives, we educate others about the benefits of nuclear technology and the career paths within the industry. Members who join our e‑board or committees build leadership experience and professional skills along the way. You’re welcome to join either of our committees: • PD Committee — Professional Development • PI Committee — Public Information Join Microsoft Teams to get connected and learn more about the committees.
